Cloudflare outage shows challenge pages to millions

Cloudflare said on Tuesday that a configuration change caused visitors to see an "Attention Required! | Cloudflare" page and the message "Verify you are human" while the network was checking your browser. Users were told "Please wait while we verify" and that "this may take a few seconds"; many shared screenshots showing the Cloudflare Ray ID, asking "Why have I been blocked?" and "What can I do to resolve this?". The banner read "Performance & security by Cloudflare". Some pages even said "Just a moment...".
